title: BlackLanturn 1.1.34
summary: Current bundled add-ons with tested BlackLanturn compatibility patches.

sections.heading: Add-ons and patches together
bullets: Updates Umbrella to6.7.98, TMDb Helper to6.19.2 and Up Next to1.3.0.
